name: Acumen
description: You have a keen intellect. Add +5 per level to your COG Checks.

name: Adaptability
description: You adjust to new morphs quickly. Apply a +10 modifier per level for Integration and Resleeving Stress Tests.

name: Allies
description: You are either part of or have a relationship with a group that has your back. Once per session, you may rely on this group for support (as a moderate rep favor). This relationship is mutual and may involve obligations. GMs should use this for plot hooks.

name: Animal Empathy
description: You have an instinctive feel for handling and working with non-sapient animals. Apply a +10 modifier to Exotic Skill: Animal Handling and similar tests.

name: Common Sense
description: Once per session, you may ask the GM what course of action your character would think best. Alternatively, the GM may use this trait to warn you of a disastrous choice.

name: Composure
description: +5 Lucidity, +1 Trauma Threshold, +10 Insanity Rating.

name: Contact
description: +10 to rep tests with one specific network when using the contact. May be taken multiple times with different contacts.

name: Danger Sense
description: +10 to Perceive Tests to avoid surprise.

name: Digital Speed
description: Infomorphs only. Reduces mesh task action timeframes by 25%.

name: Direction Sense
description: Always know directional orientation. +10 to navigation and related spatial orientation tasks.

name: Dominant Strain
description: Asyncs only. +10 to resist exsurgent virus infection (+20 at Infection Rating 33+, +30 at 66+).

name: Drone Affinity
description: No Integration Tests required when jamming drones.

name: Empathy
description: +5 per level to SAV Checks.

name: Expert Training
description: Allows one skill to be raised over 80, up to 90 max, during character creation.

name: Fitness
description: +5 per level to SOM Checks.

name: Good Instincts
description: +5 per level to INT Checks.

name: Hardening
description: Immune to stress from one category (alienation, helplessness, unknown, or violence). –10 to WIL and Persuade Tests. May be taken multiple times.

name: Hyper Linguistics
description: +10 per level to INT Checks to understand unfamiliar spoken languages (not written or non-verbal).

name: Improved Immune System
description: Biomorphs only. +10 per level to resist chemicals, diseases, drugs, and toxins.

name: Innocuous Looks
description: −10 to be spotted, identified, or remembered by appearance. Does not affect psi or mesh searches. Not available for morphs with Availability < 50.

name: Lethal
description: +1d6 DV to melee damage rolls.

name: Limberness
description: +10 per level to escape bonds, contort, or fit into small spaces.

name: Morph Familiarity
description: No Integration Tests when sleeving into one chosen morph type. May be taken multiple times for different types.

name: Natural Immunity
description: Biomorphs only. Immune to one specific drug, chemical, or toxin. Does not apply to nanodrugs or nanotoxins.

name: Pain Tolerance
description: Ignore the −10 modifier for 1 wound per level, up to a maximum of 3 wounds.

name: Patron
description: You have a powerful ally who offers one free major favor per story arc. The relationship should be defined with the GM and can include obligations.

name: Psi
description: You are infected with the Watts-MacLeod strain of the exsurgent virus, which allows use of the Psi skill and sleights. Level 1 grants psi-chi sleights; Level 2 grants both psi-chi and psi-gamma sleights. You must also take a required negative trait based on your sub-strain at no CP bonus. This required trait does not count against trait CP limits.

name: Psi Camouflage
description: Harder to detect with psi. Apply −10 modifier per level to any attempt to detect you via psi sleights. Morph version only available to biological brains.

name: Psi Defense
description: Apply +10 modifier per level to defense rolls against psi sleights. Morph version only available to biological brains.

name: Quickness
description: Apply +5 per level to REF Checks.

name: Rapid Healing
description: Biomorphs only. Morph heals naturally at twice the normal rate (not including healing aids).

name: Resolve
description: +5 per level to WIL Checks. Represents mental resolve and determination.

name: Resources
description: You possess wealth/assets. Grants bonus Morph/Gear Points and allows purchases during missions. At higher levels, grants access to rarer items and narrative control benefits. Also grants +10 modifier per level to relevant social/economic rolls.

name: Situational Awareness
description: You do not suffer the Distracted modifier on Perceive Tests even while engaged in other tasks or during combat quick Perceive Tests.

name: Skill Artifact
description: Morph contains latent skill memory. +10 per level to one GM-chosen skill (usually based on morph’s highest pool). May be taken multiple times for different skills.

name: Spatial Visualization
description: +10 to Know or Technical skill tests involving 3D visualization, shapes, volume, or spatial reasoning.

name: Stalwart
description: Apply +10 per level to WIL Checks and other fear-resistance rolls, such as Provoke Tests against intimidation or certain psi/stress effects.

name: Striking Looks
description: +10 per level to Persuade and Provoke Tests where appearance is influential.

name: Superior Numeracy
description: +10 per level to Know and Technical Tests involving mathematics, calculations, or quantitative reasoning.

name: Zoosemiotics
description: You suffer no penalty when using psi sleights on non-sapient or semi-sapient animals.
